title: Projective modules and locally polynomial algebras
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: Projective modules over polynomial rings and algebras that are locally polynomial. Quillen's patching theorem for extended modules and the method of Quillen induction; Horrocks' theorem, with an elementary proof over local rings; the Quillen–Suslin theorem that finitely generated projective modules over a polynomial ring over a field are free; automorphism groups of symmetric algebras, axiom Q and the factorization of an automorphism over two localizations; and the theorem of Bass, Connell and Wright that a finitely presented algebra which is locally a symmetric algebra is the symmetric algebra of a finitely presented module, so that locally polynomial algebras over k[y₁,…,y_r] are polynomial rings.
prerequisites: AG-CA lesson localization-local-properties-and-support (Theorems 2.1, 2.2, 4.2, 5.1: exactness of localization, localizing Hom out of a finitely presented module, Nakayama's lemma, local detection)

checks.exact_checks: python/sympy (scratch pm_checks.py): the normalization identity in the gluing lemma; the factorization of Exercise 5.2 of the patching lesson; determinant 1 for the completed unimodular row (x, y, 1-xy); Lemma 2.1 of the Horrocks lesson for f = X^2+3X+1 and g = 1+5X+10X^2 over Z_(5) (det = 31, a unit mod 5, chi(g) divisible by f); the decomposition u = g ell tau_t of Proposition 3.3 on an explicit endomorphism; an explicit factorization of X -> X + Y^2/6 over Z[1/2] and Z[1/3] as in Theorem 4.2; the identity ^c u = delta_c u delta_c^(-1); Lemmas 1.2 and 1.3 of the last lesson on explicit examples (8 Oct 2026)

open_obligations: Exercise 3.3 of locally-polynomial-algebras is stated conditionally on the non-freeness of the module P = ker(K^3 -> K, (a,b,c) -> ax+by+cz) over K = R[x,y,z]/(x^2+y^2+z^2-1) (the tangent module of the real 2-sphere); that non-freeness is not proved in the programme.
free_sources: Quillen, Projective modules over polynomial rings, Invent. Math. 36 (1976) (GDZ)
Bass-Connell-Wright, Locally polynomial algebras are symmetric algebras, Invent. Math. 38 (1977) (GDZ)
